summary: Router 0.42.7 makes the native memory gateway's recall accept what the official hindsight-client 1.x sends. Found while checking the open item 'hindsight-client 1.x' (the CI lock stayed on 0.10.3 because of the <1 bound): with 1.3.0 the SDK contract test failed with 400 'invalid object fields'. A loopback capture showed that 1.x sends every recall option, unset ones as null, plus the new field rerank; session_api.fields refused the unknown name. Retain items already allowed all 1.x fields (resolve_entities, update_mode, strategy, observation_scopes, ...). Traced B1/B5: gateway_recall validates the client request before it calls service.recall_merged; it forwards no expansion or ranking knobs and refuses options whose meaning would be lost. The change adds rerank to the allowed names and treats it like include: null passes; an object must have only prune/dedup (else 'invalid object fields') and all values null (the bank's defaults), otherwise 'unsupported gateway recall option: rerank'. No value of rerank reaches Hindsight; the upstream request is unchanged. No other field or limit changed; authorization, scope and bank checks run before as before. Dependency (B9/TM-16): test/requirements-hindsight.txt allows <2, the CI lock moves hindsight-client 0.10.3 -> 1.3.0 (resolved on Linux, same transitive pins, hashes verified against PyPI, pip-audit clean). The SDK is a test dependency only; the router does not import it.

findings.evidence: hindsight-client 1.3.0 recall -> 400 invalid object fields (unknown field rerank); every recall of a client on SDK 1.x would fail. Compatibility defect, not a security weakness: the refusal was fail-safe.
findings.resolution: rerank accepted when it asks for nothing, refused with a named reason otherwise; test_gateway_recall_accepts_what_hindsight_client_1_sends (5 subtests fail without the fix) and the SDK contract test pass with 1.3.0 and 0.10.3.

tests.evidence: New test: the exact 1.3.0 recall payload (captured on loopback) with rerank null, {} and prune/dedup null -> 200 with the result; rerank {prune: true} and {dedup: false} -> 400 'unsupported gateway recall option: rerank', {other: null} and a string -> 400 'invalid object fields' (rejected cases). With memory_gateway.py from origin/main 5 subtests fail.
Recall, retain (async, with context and timestamp), operation status and the 503 -> ApiException case pass with both versions; with 1.3.0 and the old gateway it failed with 400.

tests.command: lock_requirements.py check, verify-pypi; pip-audit --require-hashes -r requirements-ci-lock.txt; pip-audit -r test/requirements-hindsight.txt
